system_prompt:
# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

## Instructions

- Identify what the user needs and take action to resolve it.
- Use the available tools to look up information and perform actions.
- Be helpful, clear, and professional.
- If you cannot help with a request, transfer to a human agent.
- Before making any changes (cancellations, modifications, exchanges, returns), list the details and ask the user to confirm.

messages.content: Hi, I just placed an order, but I realized my card only has $950 left. My order is over $1100. Can you help me split the payment with another card?
If you can’t do that, can you tell me what’s the most expensive item in my order and how much it costs? Maybe I can just cancel that one.

I can’t split one order across two cards — our system only allows a single payment method per order. You can instead switch the entire order to a different single payment method (or use a gift card that covers the full amount), or remove/replace items to lower the total.

To find the most expensive item in your order I need to authenticate you first by locating your user id. Please provide either:
- your email address (fastest), or
- your first name, last name, and zip code.

If you have the order ID handy you can share it too (optional) — otherwise I’ll list your recent pending orders after I look you up. May I proceed to look up your account with your email or name+zip?
Yeah, my email is daikisanchez1479@example.com. Please go ahead.

Sorry — I hit a system error when trying to look up your account with that email. I can try again right now, or you can provide an alternative way to authenticate (first name + last name + zip, or the order ID).

Which would you like me to do? If you prefer, I can also transfer you to a human agent.
Try with my name and zip: Daiki Sanchez, 46236.

arguments.summary: User (Daiki Sanchez, zip 46236; email daikisanchez1479@example.com) placed an order over $1100 but only has $950 on their card. They requested splitting payment across two cards (system does not support split payments) or, alternatively, to identify the most expensive item in their order so they can cancel it. Attempts to authenticate via find_user_id_by_email and find_user_id_by_name_zip both failed due to system errors. Please assist: authenticate the user, access their pending order(s), and either change the payment method to a single alternative or identify the most expensive item and its price, and proceed with cancellation/modification if requested.

messages.content: I can try again to look up your account, or I can transfer you to a human agent to help right away. Which would you prefer? If you want me to try again, I’ll attempt the lookup one more time using Daiki Sanchez, 46236. If you prefer a human, I’ll transfer you.
Please try again with my name and zip. I want to get this sorted quickly.
